question: Why was Gemma 4 MTP slower than plain decoding on long prompts, and what restores it?
model: Gemma 4 26B-A4B-it UD-Q4_K_XL target, mtp-gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-Q8_0 head, BF16 KV

cause.verify_attention: a production multi-row verify block requested gemma4_plain prefill attention; past the resident-logit bound the global layers ran the owned-logits class kernel in batches of four rows. A one-row verify block took the same prefill route
cause.draft_attention: the head called the native attention launch, which keeps a long global row on the class kernel unless a decode variant asks for flash

change: The runner forwards the decode scope with a multi-row production verify block, and a one-row verify block takes a decode step's variants exactly (both profiles).

The layer asks the decode selector first for a multi-row block carrying a decode scope; the flash variants serve 2-16 rows from 256 keys on either packing in one launch (C side already handled tokens > 1).
_launch_prefill admits multi-row flash only under prefer_flash, so no prefill block can reach it, and skips the four-row global batching when it serves.
The draft head attends through gemma4_attention_decode_flash_long_bf16 in every profile; drafts do not decide output.

verify_block_ms_median.method: scratch: runner.forward(rows, verification=True) after an N-token prefill, rewind between, median of 8, production

row_agreement_with_one_token_decode.exact_verify: bitwise 72 of 72 rows at 120/600/1100-token prompts, 3-9 rows

short_prompts.note: prompts under 256 keys keep the class kernel; unchanged within noise

long_prompt.method: hipengine.LLM(speculative_provider='gemma4_mtp', candidate budget 4); generate_detailed vs generate_speculative_mtp_detailed on one raw prompt of cycled campaign prose, 128 greedy tokens, after a 4-token warmup of each arm; draft acceptance 100% on this prompt

validation: tests/test_gpu_gemma4_assistant_forward.py and live MTP tests passed (the adapter test after 82cdb84a3)
limitations: The long-prompt rows are one prompt of repetitive prose with full draft acceptance; real long-context acceptance will be lower.
Each row of a multi-row flash block re-reads the block's keys; a five-row block at 32K costs 2.5x a decode step.
Not measured on hip_gfx1151 (its plan has no flash decode variant, so its verify attention is unchanged; the draft head change applies there too).
